title: SO-F-07 Federated query and continuity specification: an authorised view with provenance and freshness, last-known state labelled when delivery stops, no invented status, and recovery checked against the declared objectives per data class
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-F-07) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design records SO-2.02 (Permission-aware knowledge access: retrieval governed by identity, project membership, classification, policy and jurisdiction); SO-2.12 (Federated computation behind the provider boundary) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Memev contracts that land first: SO-F-04, SO-F-12. Pages: docs/DATA-SOVEREIGNTY.md, docs/FEDERATION.md come from the federation architecture documentation (PR #223, branch docs/federation-architecture, not on main); until that merges, the first contract to need a page creates it with its Status section, labelled planned or architectural target, and the later ones extend it. Source in the fold: #222 section 13.6.1 (last-known replicated view versus live confirmation; continue local operation during partitions) and #223 FEDERATION.md (partitions, offline operation and recovery; acceptance criteria 2, 4, 7, 10). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Decision verifier D-SO-TOPOLOGY removed (settled: local-first). (4) Boundary with PG-13.1 WP13-04 (offline operation and reconcile on reconnect): this contract is the read side (authorised view, last-known label); WP13-04 owns local authority and reconcile. Cite, do not restate.

tasks.description: A node may ask a peer for an authorised view without assuming it may read the peer's memory. When delivery from the peer stops the node reports last-known state with its version and time, says the source is unreachable, and never invents a current status. Recovery objectives are declared per data class in the policy document of SO-F-04 and checked without a timing gate. This contract specifies the request and response, the continuity behaviour and the recovery check as functions of src/engine/federation; a command comes with a later contract.

criteria.statement: an authorised view request names subject, scope and purpose; the response carries the items the policy allows, each with provenance, last-confirmed time and source availability; an item outside the policy is absent, not redacted in place

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.

Stop when the work would implement a federation, replication, trust, admission or computation feature beyond the specification, schema, validator and conformance test the contract names; the product keeps the planned label on it.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
